name: JellyGlance statistics
description: Most watched titles and users this week.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="xs" p="xs" h="100%">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs" pr={36}>
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap" miw={0}>
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0} miw={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm" truncate>This week</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{data.topTitle}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Box style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Badge variant="light" color="violet">Glance</Badge></Box>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="sm" flex={1} mih={0} style={{ overflowY: "auto" }}>
  <Box flex={1} mih={0} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(max(96px, calc((100% - 12px) / 3)), 1fr))", gridAutoRows: "minmax(44px, 1fr)", gap: 6 }}>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="violet" truncate>Top title</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.topTitle}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="blue" truncate>Top user</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.topUser}</Text></Card>
  </Box>
  <Stack gap="xs">
    {data.items.map((row) =>
      <Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs">
        <Group justify="space-between">
          <Text size="sm">{row.title}</Text>
          <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{row.viewers}</Text>
        </Group>
      </Card>
    )}
  </Stack>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
